name: stray-free
title: Free of unknown pointer
fix_goal: Only pass the exact pointer returned by the allocator to p101_free, and only while this scope owns it.
fix_steps: Find the pointer passed to p101_free.
Compare it to the exact pointer returned by p101_malloc.
Do not free interior pointers, stack pointers, string literals, or borrowed pointers.
Free the original owning pointer exactly once.
Re-run ./lab.sh and confirm the stray-free lab is fixed.
lesson: Freeing a pointer that was not returned by the allocator corrupts the ownership model and can corrupt the heap.
